verdict.rationale: The plugin package format lists an optional plugin-level `hooks.json` companion surface (gh-11), and the developer docs index mentions implementing event subscriptions and webhook delivery for a plugin's MCP server (docs-59). Both point toward event-triggered automation, but neither is documented in any depth. Skill "triggering" (docs-7, docs-49) means the model decides when to load a skill, not user-defined rules firing on events. Missing for 10: documentation of the hooks.json schema and which events it supports, user-facing rule/condition authoring, end-to-end examples of automatic actions firing on events, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
